name: NASA International Space Apps Challenge
summary: Contributing mission-analysis research and data inputs to PolarWindow, a CLPS lunar mission browser. The team progressed from the local stage to the ongoing global stage.

name: IBM Bob 2.0 Hackathon
summary: Participated in an online build sprint exploring AI-assisted software-development workflows and rapid prototyping with IBM Bob.

name: The Infinity AI BuildFest
summary: Participated in CloudCamp Bangladesh’s builder community event, exploring practical AI product development and solution design.

name: Harvard HSIL Hackathon
summary: Officially selected for the Dhaka, Bangladesh Hub of the 7th Harvard HSIL Hackathon. Contributed to RadFlow, an offline-first AI-supported radiology triage prototype for resource-constrained district hospitals.
